ios.desc:
Diabetes Diary Plus: Your Smart Blood Sugar Tracker & Insulin Manager

Take control of your diabetes with Diabetes Diary Plus, the ultimate diabetes diary app for easy and stress-free diabetes management. Effortlessly log your blood sugar levels, insulin doses, and carbohydrates – all in one app. With interactive charts, you can view your glucose trends and easily track your progress. This app is more than just a carbohydrate manager – it simplifies diabetes management and helps with your daily blood sugar monitoring.

User-Friendly & Customizable
◉ Easy Logging: Enter blood sugar, insulin, and meals with just a few clicks.
◉ Charts: Track your glucose patterns and trends over weeks and months.
◉ Apple Health: Seamlessly sync your data with Apple Health and use health apps.
◉ Widgets: Keep key values in view right on your home screen or Apple Watch.
◉ Injection Timer: Get reminders for blood sugar checks and insulin injections and monitor absorption times.
◉ No Account Required: Your data remains private and secure.
◉ iCloud Syncing: Access your logs from all your devices – whether iPhone, iPad, or Mac.
◉ Apple Watch: Keep your synced glucose values in view right on your wrist thanks to our Dexcom connection.
◉ Glucose levels in mmol/L or mg/dL.
◉ Customizable fields for basal rates, ketones, notes, and activities.
◉ Carb Calculator: Quickly calculate the carbohydrates in your meals and keep an eye on your daily totals.
◉ Reminders: Set custom reminders for blood sugar checks, insulin, and meals.
◉ PDF Export: Clear, organized PDF reports for doctor visits, or export as CSV for Excel.
◉ Meal Scanner: Scan your meal and instantly see the estimated carbohydrates.

Improve your diabetes management: Regularly logging your values in a diabetes diary helps you better recognize and prevent hypoglycemia and hyperglycemia. The intuitive interface allows you to document and understand your diabetes without stress. Diabetes Diary Plus supports both type 1 and type 2 diabetics and is ideal for pregnant women with gestational diabetes. The HbA1c estimation feature allows you to effectively monitor your long-term blood sugar control and detect potential fluctuations early.

Pregnancy Feature for Expectant Mothers: Manage your blood sugar levels during pregnancy with our special feature. Quickly and easily track blood sugar, insulin, and meals to keep your health in check throughout pregnancy.

A Digital Diabetes Diary Instead of Paper: Replace your classic paper diabete
